title: During the open Showdown at Abandoned Hall (showdown.active=true, no chain), the legal move list and the action panel offer 'Activate Ability — Herald of the Arcane' ([1], [Exhaust]: Play a Recruit token), an activated ability with no [Action]/[Reaction] tag.
expected: abilityTimingClass() (activate-ability.ts:39-50) returns "standard" only when the host card is gear; for every other host type (Herald of the Arcane is a legend) an untagged activated ability falls through to `"action"` at line 49. The condition at line 514-515 then calls isLegalTiming("action", turnState), which (chain/chain-state.ts:198-208) returns true for "showdown-open". So an untagged legend/unit activated ability is offered during a Showdown Open state, contrary to rule 310.1.a / 145.2 / 347.1+338.1.a.2 and the rules text "Only cards and abilities with the Action or Reaction keywords can be played or activated in a Showdown State". Trace step 30 confirms: showdown.active=true, chain=null, moves include activateAbility{cardId: player-1-legend-ogn-265-298, abilityIndex:0} and the card def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogn/herald-of-the-arcane.ts) has no keyword/timing on the ability.
